question: Are this world and the other world truly different realities?
premises: The distinction between this world and the other world is only a matter of awareness.
Even apparent divisions of time, part, awareness, and place do not create real difference.
inference: World-distinctions are modes of awareness within an undivided reality.
uncertainties: The compound akālakalāsaṃviddeśabhede is compact and its internal relations are interpretively dense.
plain_english: Being this world or another world is only a matter of awareness; even amid apparent divisions of time, part, awareness, and place, it remains undivided.
